title: Jackanapes, Daddy Darwin's Dovecot and Other Stories
sourceTitle: Jackanapes, Daddy Darwin's Dovecot and Other Stories
author: Juliana Horatia Ewing
description: "Jackanapes, Daddy Darwin's Dovecot and Other Stories" by Juliana Horatia Ewing is a collection of children's stories written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book weaves together whimsical narratives that explore themes of childhood, social dynamics, and the impact of war on community life, centering around various characters, including young Jackanapes and the villagers of Goose Green.

authorInfo.bio: Juliana Horatia Ewing (1841–1885) wrote Old-Fashioned Fairy Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
